title: Tanzania's Plastic Bag Ban: What Travellers Need to Know
excerpt: Tanzania banned plastic carrier bags in 2019. What that means for your luggage and shopping.
body:
Since June 2019, Tanzania has banned the import, production, sale and use of plastic carrier bags. This applies to visitors too.

## Luggage

- Do not pack plastic carrier bags in your luggage.
- At the airport, bags may be checked and plastic carrier bags confiscated.
- Zip-lock bags for toiletries were generally tolerated, but keep them in your luggage and take them home.

## Duty free

Duty-free shops sometimes use plastic bags. Ask for an alternative or pack items in your hand luggage.

## Alternatives

Bring fabric bags, packing cubes and dry bags.

## Zanzibar

Zanzibar had an earlier ban on plastic bags.

## Why

Plastic damages the environment and wildlife. The ban helps keep parks, beaches and the sea clean.

## Rules change

Check the current rules before you travel.
